svg.title: Pranathi — profile and skills
svg.desc: Pranathi, third-year CSE student at IIIT Kottayam. Five-star confidence: C, C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Hugo, Web and Firebase Authentication, Cloud Functions and App Hosting. Three-star confidence: React, Flutter, React Native, iOS, Messaging, Figma and Wix.
